availability.note: Hyundai AU model page embeds configurator data for one grade (Calligraphy, '314 kW Dual Electric Motor ... AWD') in 7-seat (GOW7) and 6-seat (GOW6) builds plus a Digital Side Mirrors option pack, all priceEnabled; Build & Price itself is JS-rendered. Spec sheet is MY27. CarsGuide 2027 price table lists only Calligraphy E4 6/7-seat and DSM permutations (options, +$2,000 / +$3,000).

listPrice.note: CarsGuide MY2027 table: Calligraphy E4 (7 Seat) $119,668; footnote 'Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price ... excludes stamp duty, other government charges and options' (not the words 'before on-road costs'). Launch price $119,750 'before on-road costs' (CarExpert, CarsGuide review); the $82 drop equals LCT indexation (0.33 x $274 threshold rise / 1.1). Hyundai's own model page gives only drive-away (fscLowPrice $128,977.72, 6-seat +$2,099.99 = $2,000 x 1.05, i.e. NSW-duty drive-away); that sits above the app's Vic drive-away for $119,668 ($125,574), so it is a genuine drive-away, not a list. CarExpert's 2026 variant page says '$121,750 before on-road costs', which matches the launch 6-seat price and was rejected.

batteryKwh.note: usable 106.0 kWh; nominal 110.3 kWh on same page. Hyundai AU spec sheet 'Capacity 110.3 kWh, Voltage 610 V' is the gross/system-energy figure (press release calls it 'system energy'). V x Ah and cell count not published (Hyundai says only '48 additional cells' vs EV9 99.8 kWh), so the settlement rests on EV Database's paired figures. Held 107 replaced.

rangeKm.note: Hyundai AU MY27 spec sheet 'All Electric Range (WLTP) 600km', 21-inch wheels (only wheel offered); EV Database Performance AWD also 600 km WLTP

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: spec sheet 'Electric driving efficiency (Combined) 206Wh/km', WLTP, includes charging losses (EV Database: rated 206, vehicle 177 Wh/km); 16.6% above 106/600

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 'Cargo area - minimum: behind 3rd row / behind 2nd row (VDA) 338L / 908L'; frunk (52L AWD) not added

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarsGuide review: 'Drop both rows ... 2410 litres'; also CarsGuide boot-space page. Measurement height unstated and likely to the roof (EV Database max 2,419L); Hyundai AU publishes no folded-behind-1st-row figure and no to-the-belt-line figure was found. Matches the kia-ev9 sibling, which also holds its maximum (2,318L).

seats.note: 7 passenger (2nd row bench) standard; 6-seat is a $2,000 option

towKg.note: Braked 2500 kg, unbraked 750 kg, max ball 125 kg

warrantyYears.note: 5 years/unlimited km unconditional; extended to 7 years only with all scheduled servicing at an authorised Hyundai dealer; HV battery 8 yr/160,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; anchored to kia-ev9-gt-line-awd ($121,000, 2700), volvo-ex90-plus-single-motor ($106,990, 2700) and kia-ev9-earth-awd ($106,500, 2600)

depreciationCurve.note: judged; brand convention (one curve per brand), reconciled at wave-2 integration to the curve most rows of this brand carry
